output.scope_note: The paper is a DFT study of defects and ion transport in Li, Na and K beta/beta'' aluminas, a class of solid Na/Li/K ion conductors, but it reports only one conductivity number, a literature-cited room-temperature range for Na beta-alumina single crystals.

records.evidence_quote: has an ionic conductivity of 0.01-0.03 Scm−1
records.notes: Range quoted from ref. [8] (Lu et al., Jom 2010) for beta-alumina in single crystals at room temperature; the material is described only as 'β-alumina' in the introduction, and the paper's own calculations give no conductivity values.
